lines.text: Daily math review.
And the big review before a test.
Either way, the same question: "What should I review?"
Stumble Map is an app that shows you what to review. Just snap a photo.
Every day, just snap the worksheets that come back. Before a test, see tonight's to-do list at a glance.
First, snap. Homework, workbooks, tests: the whole page in one shot.
AI reads the problems one by one, works out which unit each one belongs to, and records ○ and ✕.
If the teacher has marked it, that mark is used. Unmarked homework is judged by AI. You can check it all before saving.
Save, and that unit rises up on the map.
From Grade 1 to Grade 12, all 110 math units on one continent. The higher the grade, the higher and steeper the land.
Colors show the stage of understanding: Not yet, Trying, Reviewed, Mastered. Solve it again two weeks later, and it's Locked in.
A red flag is a ✕ you haven't redone yet. Tap it to jump straight back to the problem and its photo.
Sometimes a stumble starts in an earlier grade. Stumble on Grade 5 "Mean", and the map traces it back to the Grade 4 unit it builds on.
Daily review is this loop: Snap. Redo. Check. Bit by bit, the map turns your color.
Then, before the test. Just pick the test date and the range, and tonight's plan is ready.
Problems to redo first. The roots of your stumbles. A final check. With time estimates, so it's clear what to do.
Check answers on the spot, and tick each one off once it's redone. Parents can get it all on one shareable page.
Photos are saved only on your own device. Works on smartphones and iPads.
Try 30 photos free. The Annual Plan gives you up to 200 photos a month. The Lens courses include one year.
For daily review, and before tests. Just snap a photo, and know what to review. Stumble Map.
